Information

First, let's train the
Digimon and enter the
"Ace of Spring" title
match that will be held
on the 3rd day 
of Spring!
Digimon will get sick if\nthey are in dirty cages!\nClean the cages often!
Food will rot after some\ntime! Digimon that eat\nrotten food will get sick!

Are you checking the
schedule often? Have
your Digimon prepared
for the day of the title
match!

Digimon that are
stressed out are more
prone to injury! Don't
put too many Digimon
in a small cage!
If you leave weakened\nDigimon in the infirmary,\nthey will slowly recover!

If you run out of bits
and can't buy food, your
Digimon will starve to
death. Be careful!

When you want more bits,
enter the Free Battles
to win some prize money!
Be careful not to
challenge opponents that
are too strong!

When a Digimon is small
and In-Training, train
it by focusing on an
ability. That's the way
to alter the course of
its digivolution!

Battle counts are
important in
digivolving! Your
Digimon may digivolve
into powerful Digimon if
you fight lots of battles!
A stressed out Digimon\nwill have a hazy head!

Digivolution is the
quickest way to become
stronger! When a Digimon
digivolves, it matures
dramatically!

A Digimon's Capacity
is like its weight! It
increases when a Digimon
digivolves!

As you win title matches
and collect medals, your
Tamer Rank increases
and you are able to add
more Digimon to your
group!

Are you keeping track of
the capacity of all your
Digimon in the Digimon
menu? Be ready to
digivolve by having at
least a cushion of 10G.

Different Digimon appear
in the same hunting
grounds depending on
whether it is day or
night!

When an icon is
displayed above a
Digimon, it needs your
attention! Take good
care of it!

When a Digimon
digivolves, you can lose
it if it exceeds
capacity! Make sure you
have enough capacity!

When your tamer rank
increases, you become
eligible to enter more
title matches!

How many times a Digimon
becomes a DigiEgg is an
important part of its
digivolution! It is key
in digivolving into a
strong Mega Digimon!

Cage training makes
Digimon hungry. When
Digimon train, reward
them with food!

Heal a Digimon's injury
or illness early on with
either bandages or
medicine! Be careful
because Digimon can die
if left unattended!

If you want to use a lot
of special attacks,
increase TP! There are
supposedly Digimon that
have three special
attacks!

Digimon are more lively
during the warm seasons
of Spring and Summer!
It's the perfect time
for training!

If you run out of items,
stock up at the shop!
It's common sense for a
tamer to always have
food and medicine on
hand!

As your Tamer Rank goes
up, more gates to
hunting grounds become
available!

Friendship can be born
between Digimon! If a
Digimon is alone in a
cage all the time, it is
difficult for friendships
to grow!

If Digimon are left
alone, they digivolve on
their own. Neglect their
training and they can
become slovenly Digimon!

Feed Digimon protein and
their attack power
increases during battle!
However, they also become
more prone to injury!

You can enter title
matches from
7:00 to 15:00! Keep track
of the time so you don't
miss your chance!

After buying a new item,
make sure you change
your settings before
going on a hunt!

If you grab your Digimon
and move them around
from cage to cage often,
they grow faster!

TP stands for Technical
Points. TP are expended
when a Digimon uses a
special attack or
support (SP)!

To enter the
championship, you need
to win the preliminaries
at least once within the
three years leading up
to it.

Watch out for a team
called the Wild Giggers!
They've trained many
Digimon with an emphasis
on power!

Tamers each have
training licenses. When
Tamer Rank increases, it
is possible to achieve
a higher level of
digivolution!

There are many battles
held in Autumn!
Get your Digimon in
good condition and
participate in as many
as you can!

After buying a new cage,
go to Cage Edit to
change your cage!
Put your Digimon in it
and you may see some new
transformations occur!

The key to relieving
Digimon stress is
to make them happy! If
they get stressed out,
they become ill!

Don't give up even if
your Digimon becomes a
DigiEgg! Its soul is
passed on and there is a
chance it will become an
even stronger Digimon!

The preliminaries and
the championship are
both held on the 5th day
of Autumn! Increase
your Tamer Rank and go
for the challenge!

During a hunt, a high
level tamer can use
items other than a rope
effectively. Devise a
plan and lure Digimon
into a trap!
The weather can change\ndepending on when you\ngo on a hunt!
When your Tamer Rank\nincreases, your Cage\nSpace increases too!

Have you seen the
Digipedia in the
Database? A tamer can
have fun collecting
various Digimon and
filling it up!

During battle, the
actions of a Digimon
differ based on its
nature!

Even Digimon supposedly
have charisma! Digimon
with high charisma are
highly trusted by their
friends!

Digivolved Digimon are
recorded in the
Digipedia! Once the
records are complete,
something good
might happen!

When you want to hunt
for a long time, it's
best to go out
in the morning!

There is an urban legend
that says that a tamer
released a Digimon
during a hunt and was
reunited with it at the
same spot!

Observe your Digimon
closely! Even though
they don't talk, you
should be able to
understand their
feelings!

Sometimes you can see
what a Digimon will
digivolve into when you
touch it right after its
parameters increase from
training!
Sukamon is hard to\ntrain! Good luck!
Some Digimon will get\nstressed out by being\nnear selfish Digimon!

A Digimon that has
become a DigiEgg still
has some of its memories
left. It can digivolve
more easily along the
same path it did before!

A waste filled cage can
cause some Digimon to
be stressed! Be sure to
clean the cages often.

While on a hunt, be on
the lookout for Digimon
that move quickly, as they
may have rare abilities!

It's difficult to wake
up a lazy Digimon once
it falls asleep, even
if you touch it!

To train Digimon for
several generations is
one way of getting
stronger! Don't worry
about failing, just take
your time!

Digimon like some cages
more than others
depending on the
Digimon! Some Digimon even
like dark wet cages!

Dragon and Beast,
Aquatic and Bird,
InsectPlant and Machine,
Holy and Dark
are all antagonists
of each other!

When a Digimon is being
disobedient, it is
easier to grab it by
touching it while
pressing お or
か !

Digimon that get along
with each other will do
things together, like
sing to relieve stress!

The Digital World has
four seasons. The
seasons change every
eight days!

Summer is the season for
training! Parameters
increase more easily
than usual!
Autumn is the season for\nbattles! There are lots\nof title matches!

Be careful during
Winter training!
Training too hard makes
Digimon prone to injury!

Digimon move from place
to place as the seasons
change. You can hunt
different Digimon
depending on the
season.

Spring and Autumn are
the best times to go on
hunts! Lots of Digimon
are out so they're
easier to catch!

During the cold seasons
of Autumn and Winter are
when the Dark species
Digimon come out!

They say rare Digimon
that you don't see often
come out in the Winter.
It's good to hunt in
the Winter sometimes!

It's Spring! How about
going on a hunt? The
Digimon are active and
there are many outside!

Wow, the Summer is hot.
Yes, indeed it is. It's
the ideal season to train
your Digimon!

Autumn is the season
that stirs the appetite!
Digimon eat a lot during
this time so be careful!

Make use of the Winter
to shop for items and
prepare for the busy
Spring!

Spring is here again!
Spring is the best
time to hunt Beast
and Bird Digimon!

Digimon don't come
outside in the Summer
since it's so hot.
However, Insectoid
Digimon are easy to hunt
even in the Summer!

There are many title
matches in Autumn, with
the Digimon Championship
as the highlight! Win the
battles of Autumn!

I have nothing left to
teach you! I hope that
you become a great
Digimon tamer! Well,
I'll see you around!

Welcome to the Digital
World. Enter your name
and register yourself
as a tamer.

You are now a Digimon
Tamer. Strive to win the
Digimon Championship
along with your Digimon.
You should be receiving
a gift soon.
It's time to enter a battle.
When Digimon are\nhungry, feed them\nfood or protein.

A Digimon that is
stressed out will become
sick if left alone. Take
it to the infirmary or
pet it often.

When a Digimon gets
sick, cure it with
medicine. If you neglect
it, it will begin to die.

If a Digimon gets
injured, heal it with
a bandage. If you neglect
it, it will begin to die.

If you do not tend to a
Digimon's low HP,
illness, injuries, or
hunger, it will begin to
die. A dying Digimon may
be lost and disappear.

A Digimon has
digivolved. A Digimon
will digivolve when its
status is raised to meet
the criteria, or after a
certain amount of time.

When a Digimon reaches the
end of its life, it will
be lost and disappear.
If it has fought at
least ten battles, it
turns into a DigiEgg.

A Digimon has turned
into a DigiEgg. Digimon
that were not lost and
turn into a DigiEgg will
be reborn stronger than
before.

Congratulations on
completing all the title
matches! You got a free
ticket! Now you can go
on hunts all you want
for free!

Congratulations! You can
control 1 Digimon now!
い =Attack
あ, う, え =Sp. Attack
お, か =Support
START=Change

Whenever capacity is
exceeded and you cannot
digivolve, reduce your
Digimon by releasing
them on the hunt map or
deleting them!

If you don't let your
Digimon battle or don't
pay them attention,
they'll escape from your
cage. Escaped Digimon
will never return.
